reason: The money is nothing and I do have the problem, receipts are a mess in those Telegram groups and my partner asks questions. But to even try it I have to export my whole work chat to some bot I've never heard of and hook it to my Google account. That's my suppliers, my prices, my staff talking. Not doing that for a free trial.
objection: I don't know who is behind this bot or where my chats and receipts end up. Supplier prices, payments, staff messages, all handed to a stranger, and then I give it my Google account on top.
would_change_my_mind: Another builder I know here using it for a few months and telling me it's fine, and a way to try it by forwarding one batch of receipts without adding it to the group or linking my Google account.
